subject: Taxes
title: Third-Party Reporting Magic
description: Learn Third-Party Reporting Magic in one minute.

hook.text: When employers report your income to the IRS via W-2 forms, compliance is 99%. When people self-report, it drops to 45%.

buildup.text: Third-party reporting creates a paper trail the IRS can cross-check.

discovery.text: Third-Party Reporting Magic reveals the mechanism or argument that changes the picture.

twist.text: The IRS tried to require Venmo and PayPal to report transactions over $600. Public outcry delayed implementation.

climax.text: Third-party reporting is the single most effective compliance tool ever invented.

punchline.text: 99% compliance with W-2s, 45% without. Information is the real enforcer.

quiz.question: What compliance rate does third-party reporting (like W-2 forms) achieve?
